properties.description: Two designs that both name something `cmp:store` do NOT overwrite each other, and the consumer's design is untouched — the corruption a plain import would cause silently; findings are attributed ours/theirs/seam with a seam finding required to name ids from BOTH sides; composing is READ-ONLY, pinned by the consumer's export content_hash being byte-identical afterwards and carrying none of the dependency's nodes; and an empty namespace is REFUSED rather than allowed to collide by omission (crates/reflow2-core/tests/compose.rs, 5 cases)
properties.name: Two designs are analysed together without either overwriting the other
